## Message guardrail (JSON questions)

Screens every message before it reaches an LLM, in one Jev request per message:
- **Whole Input Item** as state, so Jev sees `channel`, `product` and `message` together
- Questions defined in **JSON**, including a structured `instructions` object

The Code node turns the probabilities into **pass / review / block** with thresholds you control.

Select your **Jev credential** on the Jev node, then click **Execute workflow**.
